thread:
Rina: Following up from All-Hands 1: we had lots of questions about credits, quotas, and rate limits. I want to capture the agreed defaults and next steps so CS and Sales have consistent answers.

Leah: Agreed. Quick bullets: promo credits have explicit expiry (shown in Console) and are non-transferable by default; we will handle rare reissues case-by-case. Rate limits are org-scoped by default; per-key/project caps are available as opt-ins. Trials default to full consumption but we will offer a managed-trial toggle to throttle before credits are exhausted.

Sam: Billing notes: any reissue requires finance approval and a recorded justification. For committed contracts, unused committed credits are treated per SOW. We'll add an audit field in the billing console for manual extensions.

Diego: Infra: we can add a header `X-Quota-Mode: hard|soft` and emit `quota.alert` webhooks at thresholds. Managed-trial flow: at soft threshold send `quota.alert`, then start returning 429 with `Retry-After` when throttling. Example headers: 
X-RateLimit-Limit: 1000
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-Quota-Mode: soft
Retry-After: 60

Maya: Support playbook: when customers report accidental burn, collect org id, api-key, timestamps, and desired remedy (extension vs config). Offer a one-time extension template and recommend enabling managed trials for future protection.

Asha: Sales: need a clear one-pager for prospects listing default limits for Hosted, Dedicated entitlements, and how promos work. Also clarify that Dedicated offers contractable higher baselines and capacity reservations.

policy-bot: policy.change recorded 2025-09-15T15:00Z: added `managed_trial` flag and `quota.alert` webhook.

Rina: Action items: (1) Product to draft public FAQ and internal playbook (Rina) (2) Infra to ship `X-Quota-Mode` header + webhooks (Diego) (3) Billing to add extension audit field + approval flow (Sam) (4) Support to add canned replies (Maya) (5) Sales to get one-pager copy (Asha). I'll add PR links here when ready.

Leah: Thanks. Please make the FAQ clear: promo credits expire on X date, default limits are org-level, and managed trials are available by opt-in. Publish by end of week.

Rina: Roger. I'll post the draft here when it's up. Thanks everyone! :white_check_mark:
